author: PicklePenguickle
body:
I am PicklePenguickle and I would like to post an appeal because I feel like a 5 day ban was a bit excessive.. All I did was throw a beacon over the edge because A different player kept deleting it every time i placed it, I was trying to put iron under it and make a speed beacon for my team. (A mod told me i could long ago) So every time I placed it, It would be deleted by the player. I eventually got frustrated that the player was doing that so I decided to just get rid of it. I had not known it would be a team greif. When I discussed the issue with Acceqted, He was very polite and professional with me but was going to let me off with just a kick. So then I decided to just leave the server because i knew I would be kicked anyway. However, After I returned to the server Acceqted said "Okay, for that you get this" And gave me a 5 day ban without warning me. I did not mention the name of the player because I do not feel that it was serious enough for them to be punished. If you would like the name of the player, Please message me.
-PicklePenguickle

title: Appeal

replies.author: Acceqted
replies.body:
Hey there, 

1. If was a four day ban. Not 5.

2. Even though one teammate is bothering you, doesn't mean you have to destroy your teams beacon.

3. Avoiding a kick by leaving the server isn't really a way things work. You left me in the middle of a conversation. And from my perspective came back with a rather snappy attitude. I then checked your history and found out you already had a punishment for team griefing. Therefore, you punishment was brought up to a higher severity, a four day ban.

4. The name of the player is no longer needed.


This appeal has been denied. I'll leave it open for 24 hours if you have anything to say and a senior to over read. Thanks. I always highly hope you won't ban evade [Going on another account while banned on an account you own]. As I hope to remind you, that will result in a permanent ban.

Regards, Josh/Acceqted
